```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  int tiles = BLK / DIM;
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  uint32_t a_base = 0;
  uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles * tiles_K * DIM;
  int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    // Hoist B-scale staging outside the i0 loop.
    // B data is constant across all i0 iterations for this j0.
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
      memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);

    // Pre-load B tiles into scratchpad ONCE for this j0 block.
    // gemmini_flush inside the i0 loop does not wipe scratchpad SRAM contents,
    // so B tiles loaded here remain valid across all i0 iterations.
    gemmini_flush(0);
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles; j++)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
        gemmini_extended_mvin2(
          (void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
          b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
    // Fence to ensure B tiles are fully committed to scratchpad SRAM
    // before the i0 loop issues compute that depends on them.
    gemmini_fence();

    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      // Stage A scales (unavoidable: A_scales_row has stride > BLK in dim-1).
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++)
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);

      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // PROF accel
      // Full reset of accelerator command queue and configuration state.
      // Scratchpad SRAM contents (including B tiles at b_base) are preserved.
      gemmini_flush(0);

      // Step 1: Configure execution format (must precede scale loads).
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY,
                                  1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

      // Step 2: Load A scales (sel=0) then B scales (sel=1).
      // B scale data was staged into B_s once per j0, reused here each i0.
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Step 3: Load A tiles into scratchpad.
      // B tiles are already resident at b_base from the outer j0 setup above.
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++)
          gemmini_extended_mvin(
            (void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
            a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);

      // Step 4: Configure output stride and requantizer bounds.
      // i_bound=tiles, j_bound=tiles, k_bound=tiles_K must match loop_ws_spad args.
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors,
                                   tiles, tiles, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Step 5: Execute fused weight-stationary matmul.
      // B is at BANK_NUM*BANK_ROWS (top of scratchpad) — same address as loaded above.
      // mx_loop_spad_marker is one-shot: gemmini_loop_ws_spad re-issues funct 24
      // internally via the macro before funct 8 (LOOP_WS).
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles, tiles, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0,
                           a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false,
                           NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Step 6: Drain BF16 results from mx_smem to DRAM, row by row.
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++)
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(
          &C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
          SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);

      // Step 7: Full memory barrier — host must not read C_hw until fence completes.
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
